scorecard.rationale: Several standalone cinnamaldehyde maze comparisons were inconclusive. Isolated injected beta-caryophyllene results concern a different exposure and task. The newly verified sodium benzoate article concerns a reported cinnamon metabolite administered independently and measures cerebellar anatomy. It cites anxiety-related behavior from separate work. Human stress and Parkinson surveys provide no attributable ground cinnamon anxiety result. The mechanistic findings leave the frozen claim open.
